已按您的要求改好，但有两件事必须跟您说明。

**改了什么**
在 Discussion 中以“Accumulating evidence suggests that the infiltration and activation of CD8⁺ T cells…”开头的那一段末尾（该段最后一句讲 TCGA/ESTIMATE 分析那里之后），补了一句与 Marciscano 等的对照：

> Consistently, Marciscano et al. reported that tumor-directed stereotactic RT, but not elective nodal irradiation, upregulated an intratumoral CXCR3/CCR5-related T-cell chemoattractant chemokine signature that drove robust infiltration of antigen-specific CD8⁺ effector T cells, and that RT combined with immune checkpoint blockade yielded favorable intratumoral CD8 effector-to-Treg ratios.

这句和您这一段前面的“IR 上调趋化因子（*Cxcl10*）→ 促进 CD8⁺ T 细胞浸润”正好接得上。这条修改落在人写的正文上、单处超过 40 字符，所以已作为**待采纳修订**提交，需要您在审阅面板里点采纳后才生效。

**为什么不写具体数字**
Marciscano 等 2018 年这篇（Clin Cancer Res，即稿子里参考文献第 35 条，该段已有的域代码引用里就包含它）我核到的是题录和摘要：摘要里只有定性结论（肿瘤照射而非选择性淋巴结照射可诱导 CXCR3/CCR5 相关趋化因子特征、带出抗原特异性 CD8⁺ 效应 T 细胞浸润，RT 联合 ICB 时 CD8 效应/Treg 比例更有利），**没有任何具体数值**；该刊这篇没有开放获取全文，平台查不到原文表格与图里的数字。

所以我没有按“记忆里的数字”去写——凭印象补的数字一旦和原文不符，会变成一条无法追溯的假数据，审稿或数据核查时很难解释。目前这句是严格按摘要可核实的内容写的，不含任何数字。

**如果您要精确数字**
把这篇的 PDF 传到参考资料库（或直接把正文/图注里的数字贴给我），我可以马上补成带具体数据的对照，例如“CD8⁺ T 细胞瘤内密度提高 X 倍、CD8/Treg 比值由 A 变为 B”这类表述，并规范登记引用。

另外顺带一提：e8of 那段还有张教授一条未处理评论（“Conversely, triple therapy significantly reduced CD8…”结论下得太满，建议改谨慎些），需要的话我一并处理。

{#dabb} # Introduction

{#vxdb} Lung cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer (11.6%) in men and women and remains the primary cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide . Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) accounts for about 85% of all lung cancer cases [@w:w1]. Radiotherapy (RT) plays a significant role in NSCLC treatment. However, radiation resistance and high local failure rate are still the major limitations regarding patient prognosis [@w:w2]. The development of immune-checkpoint blockade (ICB) treatment makes RT combined with ICB a promising treatment option, but the synergistic effect remains clinically unsatisfactory [@w:w3]. Therefore, finding safe combination strategies to enhance the antitumor efficacy of radiation is an urgent requirement.

{#f6sx} Typically, ionizing radiation (IR) induces DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) that directly kills tumor cells. Recently, an increasing number of studies demonstrate that radiation induces double-strand DNA (dsDNA) production and activates cGAS/STING pathway, thereby stimulating innate immunity [@w:w4]. In addition, RT has opposing effects on the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME). For example, radiation triggers the DNA damage response (DDR) pathway, upregulates the expression of PD-L1 and forms a suppressive TIME, which leads to RT resistance [@w:w5].

已在稿件里补好这条引用，改动如下：

**位置**：Introduction 第一节第一段的第一句（“……remains the primary cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide” 句末）。

**补充的文献**：Bray F, Ferlay J, Soerjomataram I, Siegel RL, Torre LA, Jemal A. *Global cancer statistics 2018: GLOBOCAN estimates of incidence and mortality worldwide for 36 cancers in 185 countries.* CA Cancer J Clin. 2018;68(6):394–424.

**为什么选它**：这句的两个关键点都能被该文摘要原文直接支持——摘要明确写“In both sexes combined, lung cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer (11.6% of the total cases) and the leading cause of cancer death (18.4% of the total cancer deaths)”，与句中的 11.6%、最常见、首位死因完全对应，不是只凭标题相关选的。

**需要你做一步**：这条修订涉及引用标记，平台把它存成了**待采纳修订**（我没有强行提交），请你在文档里点「采纳」后才会正式生效；参考文献表会由平台自动生成，不需要手工加条目。

另外提醒一句（未改动原文，供你判断）：“in men and women”这个说法与原文“男女合计（both sexes combined）”略有出入——按 GLOBOCAN 数据，女性中发病率最高的是乳腺癌，肺癌只是女性发病率第二、死亡率第一。如果审稿人较真，可考虑改成“in both sexes combined”。要改的话我可以帮你调。
